The 2011 date in the team note isn't supported by what I found. Planning started after a 2008 feasibility study, a preliminary operational plan is dated 2010 (published in June 2011), and the baiting campaign ran June to August 2021, so 2021 is the answer if "start" means the field eradication. My earlier claim that the campaign succeeded was wrong: UNESCO documents say the 2021 attempt was unsuccessful and a second attempt is planned.

CONFIDENCE: 55
